svg.title: ABA: pointer-only versus tagged CAS
svg.desc: Two worker timelines with stack snapshots after every atomic step. Pointer-only CAS resurrects an owned node; tagged CAS rejects the stale observation and retries.

g.text: Initial stack: A → B → C → null | head (A, 0)
INVALID: B is reachable and owned by Worker 2.
Initial stack: A → B → C → null | head (A, 0)
VALID: stale CAS rejected; retry removes A.
